sprint: Image Studio's Cut Out Objects tool learns to look in several marked-out areas at once — rectangle, circle, or a freehand outline — and its results grid now starts with nothing picked, so 'Make One Picture' only ever composes what the child deliberately chose.
task:
SEVERAL AREAS, ANY SHAPE. The single _extractArea rect becomes _extractAreas[], each entry {kind:'rect'|'circle'|'free', bbox, points?} in working-buffer pixels; an empty list still means 'search the whole picture'. A three-button shape picker (Box / Circle / Draw) sits in the tool's own sub-panel, and every marked area renders as its own SVG marker on a pointer-events:none overlay so the child can see exactly where the tool will look.

THE SETTLED DESIGN, HONOURED RATHER THAN RE-OPENED: pre-masking the source to a circle or freehand shape was rejected earlier because extractSheet samples the crop's four CORNERS for its background estimate, and a masked corner would hand it fabricated pixels. So each pass crops to the shape's plain BOUNDING BOX (real pixels only) and objects whose CENTRE falls outside the shape are dropped afterwards via _pointInArea — bbox reject first, then a normalized-ellipse test for circles (per-axis, so it stays correct for ovals) and ray-casting for freehand outlines. A rect's filter is a no-op, which keeps the already-shipped single-rect behaviour byte-identical.

MULTIPLE PASSES, ONE GRID: _runExtractPasses chains one extractSheet call per area sequentially, each with its own .catch so one bad area can never sink the rest, then merges the results and de-dupes by source-space centre and size within 4px — two overlapping areas finding the same object yield one tile, and the dropped duplicate's object URL is revoked rather than leaked.

ONE REAL APP BUG FOUND BY THE FRESH SUITE: the merge/filter code read a nonexistent it.box with width/height fields, when the extractor's real fields are bboxOriginal with w/h (tools/sheet-extractor/js/extractor.js:513). The rect path masked it completely (its filter is a no-op), but circles dropped everything and the de-dupe compared degenerate centres. Fixed at source.

ASK C — NOTHING PICKED BY DEFAULT: _extractPicked now initializes to an EMPTY Set after every extraction. 'Make One Picture (N)' stays hidden until two or more tiles are deliberately ticked, and 'Use All N' is hidden below two results.

TEARDOWN: leaving the tool or closing the modal clears _extractAreas and any in-flight drag; _areaShape deliberately survives as a preference, the same way brush size does.

VERIFIED 60/60, zero page errors, via a fresh image_studio_areas_verify.mjs (scratch-only; the prior suites were lost with the old container). Section A (13) rect: a marked rect finds exactly the red object and never looks at the others, zero tiles picked by default, reset restores whole-picture search. B (13) circle & freehand: a circle finds exactly the green object; B5a-B5d is the decisive differential on its own dedicated fixture — the SAME bounding box keeps both squares as a rect but drops the corner square as a circle, proving the ellipse test is genuinely live rather than the filter passing everything. C (8): two areas merge, a third registers, tiny drags under 4px are ignored, and overlapping areas de-dupe to the same 2 tiles. D (13) picking, compose gating and Use All contracts, including the {dataURL,width,height} payload shape and that the single-picture callback is not also fired. E (4) compose end to end. F (4) teardown. G (4) the Trim Picture crop drag is unaffected (the two gestures share machinery but land in different fields — marking where to LOOK never arms the pair that TRIMS). H (1) zero page errors.

FOUR TEST-SIDE FIXES, all disclosed, every one STRENGTHENED rather than weakened: B5 originally 'passed' 0 tiles only because the unfixed it.box bug dropped everything — replaced with the dedicated rect-vs-circle differential above, one check becoming five. D8 asserted the modal was REMOVED from the DOM, an impossible premise since _hide() only class-hides it — now asserts it exists AND carries hidden, the real teardown contract. Section C inherited _areaShape='free' from Section B (the deliberate persistence feature) — fixed with an explicit shape re-select plus its own check. And the shape-button matcher looked for internal kind names when the rendered labels are Box/Circle/Draw.

Full regression: both goldenBuild suites (World Builder v1 and v2) PASS. renderer/slideRenderer.js is untouched, so the Museum Gallery canonical hashes are not the gate for this ship. Cache-bust ?v=0361 -> ?v=0362 across all 59 tags. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder change — tools/world-builder/, tools/world-builder-v2/ and tools/sheet-extractor/ are completely untouched; confined to js/pictureStudio.js, css/style.css and index.html.
